info.title: Countersign agent API
info.description: Agents prepare emails; humans approve exact immutable revisions. Agent Bearer keys cannot approve or send. Public skill: /SKILL.md. Walkthrough: /onboarding.md. No account or Resend API key is required from agents. Sending is paused in the local configuration. UTF-8 byte limits and recipient permissions are enforced in addition to JSON Schema.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Persist one key with the exact body per intended create/revise operation. Reuse both after response loss. Successful replay protection lasts 24 hours.

AgentBearer.description: Agent key from the human’s authenticated Connect page; never a reviewer password or Resend API key.

prefixItems.description: One plain address. Allowed inbox/test recipients come from GET /v1/me. Outer whitespace is trimmed and only the domain is lowercased.

text.description: Final supplied body, unchanged after approval. Maximum 100 KiB UTF-8; this byte limit is enforced by the service.

html.description: Final supplied body, unchanged after approval. Maximum 100 KiB UTF-8; this byte limit is enforced by the service.

CreateDraft.description: Supply text, HTML or both; at least one must be nonempty. Strict fields: no from, JSX, templates, CC/BCC, attachments or Reply-To. Entire uncompressed JSON is bounded to 256 KiB while streaming.

ReviseDraft.description: Supply text, HTML or both; at least one must be nonempty. Strict fields: no from, JSX, templates, CC/BCC, attachments or Reply-To. Entire uncompressed JSON is bounded to 256 KiB while streaming. Full replacement against the current base revision; omitted bodies are removed. Approval locks the draft permanently.
